ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering the Depths of Child Care Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the child care fraud schemes in Minnesota, including the Feeding Our Future scheme, and follow the money to uncover the extent of the fraud and those involved.
questions: Who was involved in the schemes?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale fraud scheme and bring those responsible to justice. By following the money and investigating the financial transactions, we may be able to identify other individuals and organizations involved in the scheme.
